notes: The previously cited FeatureServer/39 layer is a last-30-days feed, not the official 2024 incidents surface.
The operational 2024 packet uses the direct CSV export from the official DC open-data landing page and the MPD year-end crime table on dailycrime.
The source block-group field is populated on all but 13 rows in 2024.
The 2024 surface has no 0,0 coordinate failures.
Rows missing source block groups are concentrated on boundary streets such as Eastern Avenue and Southern Avenue.
HOMICIDE, ROBBERY, BURGLARY, and MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT map directly and reconcile within two incidents or better.
THEFT F/AUTO plus THEFT/OTHER is the accepted larceny family aggregation and stays within 64 incidents of the official combined theft-family total.
ASSAULT W/DANGEROUS WEAPON is treated as a local analogue for aggravated_assault because it closes exactly to the MPD year-end anchor and retains spatial utility.
SEX ABUSE remains blocked because the public MPD category is not treated as the repo's rape offense.
Most incidents can be allocated by source block-group field alone.
A small coordinate fallback recovers five of the thirteen rows missing source block groups.
The remaining losses are tiny and occur on border streets, not from broad geocoding failure.
